title: The weekly EIA estimate
dek: Heavy Reading's weekly estimate of the change in US commercial crude oil stocks ahead of the EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report: the stock identity printed as exact equations, a methods entry for every line with its source series and vintage, the combined forecaster with its weights formula, scoring definitions as formulas, the tested-and-rejected methods, a tutorial, a line-by-line weekly explainer, and the live record against the prints.

sources.vintage: Weekly Petroleum Status Report series through the week ending Oct 23, 2026; monthly benchmarks (Petroleum Supply Monthly / EIA-914) through Aug 2026, publication-lagged eight weeks in the estimator; live estimate record from Nov 3, 2026; pool member and direction check from public vessel-tracking departure records from the week ending Nov 6, 2026 (Monday strike)
